subject: 现存正殿

source_note: 现存紫宸殿建于安政二年（1855），不可把平安宫旧殿年代作为这座建筑的年代。 图版聚焦正殿立面与中央台阶，不并入周围回廊。
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: a Fanggu heritage line plate. Image 1 is the actual monument PHOTO and controls geometry. Image 2 is ONLY the project black fine-contour STYLE sample; never transfer its Buddha subject. Draw the named Japanese building accurately as a complete, isolated elevation at nearly frontal view. Fine sparse black ink contours with a few structural lines; no broad dark fills, hatching, pencil grain or opaque silhouettes. Pure flat opaque WHITE #FFFFFF canvas, including every blank region inside and outside the subject. Center with generous margins. No shadow, gradient, texture, glow, checkerboard, color, text, labels, signage, people, foliage, surrounding buildings, watermark or frame. Subject: Kyoto Imperial Palace Shishinden, the ACTUAL 1855 ceremonial hall: broad single-level nine-bay facade, huge gently sloped hinoki-bark roof, raised central stair and shaded veranda. Show the hall alone, not the nearby corridor or cherry tree.
